children: MediciNova will terminate its Standby Equity Purchase Agreement with Yorkville, effective September 8, 2026, after providing notice on August 31, 2026. The $30.0 million equity facility, signed July 30, 2025, resulted in sales of 175,000 shares at $1.39–$1.40 per share for $0.2 million. At termination, there are no outstanding borrowings, advance notices, or shares to be issued, and no fees are due by either party. The move simplifies MediciNova's capital framework with minimal immediate impact on liquidity.
: End unused equity facility to streamline financing options
